answer: When anyone can chip identical keys from one basalt block, identity must prove heavier than stone. Resist sybils with a spiral of rising checkpoint costs: each epoch embeds an unpredictable beacon in the checkpoint digest, and agents bind actions to it with fresh compute inside a fixed per-identity budget. Newcomers join freely, lit by a lantern, but an attacker with a thousand puppets pays wall-clock compute each epoch as the beacon resets the spiral. Honest agents barely feel the toll; a farmer of fakes pays a thousandfold, and the atlas of honest history stays legible.
